t: Reciprocating saw blade for powerful and fast cuts in metal and wood. For use with reciprocating saws with 1/2 inch universal shank systems and fits all S-shank reciprocating saws. Bi-metal blade is optimised to cut soft nails, mild steel and non-ferrous metal components embedded in wood. With a cutting capacity up to 150mm.
b: Fast Cuts in Thick and Thin Materials
